mapper.select: SELECT homepage_id, row_count, total_count FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING a USING dual ON (a.homepage_id = #{homepage_id}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.row_count = #{row_count}, a.total_count = #{total_count} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( homepage_id, locker_use_yn, row_count, total_count ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, 'Y', #{row_count}, #{total_count} )
